Subject: Discrepancy on Jun 2027 invoice (attached)

Hi Markus,

We reviewed invoice Polaris_Invoice_202706 and saw three line items that appear duplicated for June usage (connectors + ingestion). Total variance is €12,430 gross. I've attached the PDF and the ledger export. Can Redwood confirm whether this was a billing error or a plan change we missed?

We are preparing a formal dispute for our accounts team but wanted to loop you first to speed resolution — Polaris prefers a credit rather than a refund if possible, but we need VAT routing guidance (this includes EU-Poland activity).

Thanks,
Elena Petrova

Subject: Re: Discrepancy on Jun 2027 invoice (attached)

Hi Elena — thanks for flagging and for the invoice PDF.

Short answer: we believe this was a duplicate ingestion attribution that slipped through during a connector rollout on 2027-06-11. Apologies. We'll propose a segmented credit so Polaris can apply it across affected cost centers rather than a single line credit.

Next steps from our side:
- I'll loop in Billing ops and our reconciliation lead (Priyom) to propose a credit schedule and VAT treatment.
- Can you confirm whether Polaris prefers credits applied across multiple legal entities (Polaris EU vs Polaris US) or a single corporate-level credit? That will determine whether we issue VAT-exclusive or VAT-inclusive credit memos.

Markus Klein
Head of Revenue Operations | Redwood Inference
markus.klein@redwoodinference.com

From: priyom_das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elena Petrova <elena@polaris-analytics.com>, markus_klein <markus.klein@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Polaris Billing <billing@polaris-analytics.com>, Marta Kowalski <m.kowalski@cloudacct.eu>
Date: Wed, 18 Aug 2027 08:30:00 -0700
Subject: Proposed segmented rebate schedule + VAT handling

Hi Elena / team — following internal reconciliation, attached is a proposed segmented rebate schedule (proposed_rebate_schedule.xlsx) and the rationale:

Summary: total gross variance €12,430; we propose a three-piece credit:
- Credit A (Connectors): €6,700 gross — issue immediate credit memo to Polaris EU (VAT-inclusive)
- Credit B (Ingestion spike): €4,120 gross — apply as staged credit over two invoice cycles (50% now, 50% next month) to Polaris US (VAT-exempt)
- Credit C (Misc tagging duplicates): €1,610 gross — goodwill credit to corporate head account (no VAT changes)

VAT notes:
- For Credit A we will re-issue a VAT-inclusive credit memo to the EU legal entity. To support Poland VAT reclaim we need the tax_certificate_poland.pdf (please confirm) and the local VAT reg number for the Polaris EU entity.
- For Credit B, if Polaris confirms US billing jurisdiction for those connectors, we will issue net credits (no EU VAT) and Polaris can internally reallocate.

Action items for Polaris:
1) Confirm legal entity mapping for affected line items (EU vs US)
2) Provide VAT registration number for Polaris EU and the tax_certificate_poland.pdf if available
3) Confirm whether staged credit timing is acceptable

I attached the spreadsheet with line-item mapping and the draft credit memos. Once Polaris confirms we will schedule the credit memos and send accounting notification and a DocuSign credit acceptance form.

Thanks,
Priyom Das
Billing & Revenue Reconciliation Lead | Redwood Inference
priyom.das@redwoodinference.com
Attachment: proposed_rebate_schedule.xlsx
From: Elena Petrova <elena@polaris-analytics.com>
To: priyom_das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>, markus_klein <markus.klein@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Polaris Billing <billing@polaris-analytics.com>, Marta Kowalski <m.kowalski@cloudacct.eu>
Date: Thu, 19 Aug 2027 11:19:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Proposed segmented rebate schedule + VAT handling

Hi Priyom / Markus — thanks for the clear breakdown, that structure looks workable. A few clarifications from our side:

- Polaris confirms Credit A and C are EU-resident costs and should be routed to Polaris EU (we will supply VAT reg no. by EOD Friday).
- Credit B should be applied to Polaris US (we prefer staged credit as proposed).
- We will send tax_certificate_poland.pdf in a separate secure upload to Marta (cc'd).
- One ask: can Redwood mark the credit memos with the original invoice reference and include VAT-exclusive amounts in the memo notes so our tax team can reconcile quickly?

Once we have the formal credit memos we will sign the DocuSign. Please confirm timeframe for issuing the first tranche.

Best,
Elena

Attachment: (will upload tax_certificate_poland.pdf to Marta)

Date: Fri, 20 Aug 2027 15:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Proposed segmented rebate schedule + VAT handling

All — confirmed. Next steps and timeline:

1) Priyom will issue Credit A VAT-inclusive memo by 2027-08-25 once Polaris EU VAT reg no. and the Poland tax certificate are received. Memo will include original invoice ref and VAT-exclusive breakdown in the notes.
2) Credit B first tranche (50%) will be processed 2027-08-30 as a net credit to Polaris US; second tranche scheduled 2027-09-30.
3) Credit C will be issued as a one-off goodwill credit on 2027-08-25 to the corporate head account.
4) We will send a DocuSign acceptance for signature alongside the memos. Finance contact for Redwood: laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com; Polaris accounting contact: billing@polaris-analytics.com.

Please reply if any of the dates conflict. Once Elena confirms VAT reg no. we'll kick off the memos.

Markus Klein
Head of Revenue Operations | Redwood Inference
markus.klein@redwoodinference.com
